description: Queensland Transport and Roads Investment Program —- to is a series of datasets listed in Australian national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Transport and Main Roads. The Queensland Transport and Roads Investment Program 2019-20 to 2022-23 (QTRIP) outlines the Department of Transport and Main Roads current and planned investment in road and transport infrastructure across Queensland over a four-year period. For more information, please visit the Department of Transport and Main Roads website. Coverage: Transport and Main Roads. The portal lists 14 near-identical datasets in this series (one per year, month, area or site), grouped in this record; the first few are linked. The portal files it under the publisher Transport and Main Roads. Its tags are QTRIP, infrastructure, investment, project, tmr. It offers 6 resource(s) in CSV, TXT. The portal shows 2025-11-11 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-au-portal.
